verses.original: בְּ֭נִי שְׁמֹ֣ר אֲמָרָ֑י תִּצְפֹּ֥ן וּ֝מִצְוֺתַ֗י אִתָּֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: bə·nî šə·mōr ’ă·mā·rāy tiṣ·pōn ū·miṣ·wō·ṯay ’it·tāḵ
verses.literal: My son keep my words and treasure my commandments within you

verses.original: שְׁמֹ֣ר מִצְוֺתַ֣י וֶחְיֵ֑ה וְ֝תוֹרָתִ֗י כְּאִישׁ֥וֹן עֵינֶֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: šə·mōr miṣ·wō·ṯay weḥ·yêh wə·ṯō·w·rā·ṯî kə·’î·šō·wn ‘ê·ne·ḵā
verses.literal: Keep my commandments and live guard my teachings as the apple of your eye

verses.original: קָשְׁרֵ֥ם עַל־ אֶצְבְּעֹתֶ֑יךָ כָּ֝תְבֵ֗ם עַל־ ל֥וּחַ לִבֶּֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: qā·šə·rêm ‘al- ’eṣ·bə·‘ō·ṯe·ḵā kā·ṯə·ḇêm ‘al- lū·aḥ lib·be·ḵā
verses.literal: Tie them to your fingers write them on the tablet of your heart

verses.original: אֱמֹ֣ר לַֽ֭חָכְמָה אָ֑תְּ אֲחֹ֣תִי תִקְרָֽא׃ לַבִּינָ֥ה וּ֝מֹדָ֗ע
verses.transliteration: ’ĕ·mōr la·ḥā·ḵə·māh ’āt ’ă·ḥō·ṯî ṯiq·rā lab·bî·nāh ū·mō·ḏā‘
verses.literal: Say to wisdom You are my sister and call understanding your kinsman

verses.original: לִ֭שְׁמָרְךָ זָרָ֑ה מֵאִשָּׁ֣ה מִ֝נָּכְרִיָּ֗ה הֶחֱלִֽיקָה׃ אֲמָרֶ֥יהָ
verses.transliteration: liš·mā·rə·ḵā zā·rāh mê·’iš·šāh min·nā·ḵə·rî·yāh he·ḥĕ·lî·qāh ’ă·mā·re·hā
verses.literal: that they may keep you from the adulteress . . . from the stranger with seductive words

verses.original: כִּ֭י בְּחַלּ֣וֹן בֵּיתִ֑י נִשְׁקָֽפְתִּי׃ בְּעַ֖ד אֶשְׁנַבִּ֣י
verses.transliteration: kî bə·ḥal·lō·wn bê·ṯî niš·qā·p̄ə·tî bə·‘aḏ ’eš·nab·bî
verses.literal: For at the window of my house I looked through the lattice

verses.original: וָאֵ֤רֶא בַפְּתָאיִ֗ם אָ֘בִ֤ינָה בַבָּנִ֗ים נַ֣עַר חֲסַר־ לֵֽב׃
verses.transliteration: wā·’ê·re ḇap·pə·ṯā·yim ’ā·ḇî·nāh ḇab·bā·nîm na·‘ar ḥă·sar- lêḇ
verses.literal: I saw among the simple I noticed among the youths a young man lacking judgment

verses.original: עֹבֵ֣ר בַּ֭שּׁוּק אֵ֣צֶל פִּנָּ֑הּ יִצְעָֽד׃ וְדֶ֖רֶךְ בֵּיתָ֣הּ
verses.transliteration: ‘ō·ḇêr baš·šūq ’ê·ṣel pin·nāh yiṣ·‘āḏ wə·ḏe·reḵ bê·ṯāh
verses.literal: crossing the street near her corner strolling down the road to her house

verses.original: בְּנֶֽשֶׁף־ בְּעֶ֥רֶב י֑וֹם וַאֲפֵלָֽה׃ בְּאִישׁ֥וֹן לַ֝֗יְלָה
verses.transliteration: bə·ne·šep̄- bə·‘e·reḇ yō·wm wa·’ă·p̄ê·lāh bə·’î·šō·wn lay·lāh
verses.literal: at twilight as the day was fading . . . into the dark of the night . . .

verses.original: וְהִנֵּ֣ה אִ֭שָּׁה לִקְרָאת֑וֹ שִׁ֥ית ז֝וֹנָ֗ה וּנְצֻ֥רַת לֵֽב׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hin·nêh ’iš·šāh liq·rā·ṯōw šîṯ zō·w·nāh ū·nə·ṣu·raṯ lêḇ
verses.literal: Then a woman came out to meet him [with] the attire of a harlot and cunning of heart

verses.original: הִ֣יא הֹמִיָּ֣ה וְסֹרָ֑רֶת רַגְלֶֽיהָ׃ לֹא־ יִשְׁכְּנ֥וּ בְּ֝בֵיתָ֗הּ
verses.transliteration: hî hō·mî·yāh wə·sō·rā·reṯ raḡ·le·hā lō- yiš·kə·nū bə·ḇê·ṯāh
verses.literal: She is loud and defiant her feet do not remain at home

verses.original: פַּ֤עַם׀ בַּח֗וּץ פַּ֥עַם בָּרְחֹב֑וֹת תֶאֱרֹֽב׃ וְאֵ֖צֶל כָּל־ פִּנָּ֣ה
verses.transliteration: pa·‘am ba·ḥūṣ pa·‘am bā·rə·ḥō·ḇō·wṯ ṯe·’ĕ·rōḇ wə·’ê·ṣel kāl- pin·nāh
verses.literal: Now in the street now in the squares she lurks at every corner

verses.original: וְהֶחֱזִ֣יקָה בּ֭וֹ וְנָ֣שְׁקָה־ לּ֑וֹ הֵעֵ֥זָה פָ֝נֶ֗יהָ וַתֹּ֣אמַר לֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·he·ḥĕ·zî·qāh bōw wə·nā·šə·qāh- lōw hê·‘ê·zāh p̄ā·ne·hā wat·tō·mar lōw
verses.literal: She seizes him and kisses him she brazenly . . . says to him

verses.original: שְׁלָמִ֣ים עָלָ֑י זִבְחֵ֣י הַ֝יּ֗וֹם שִׁלַּ֥מְתִּי נְדָרָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: šə·lā·mîm ‘ā·lāy ziḇ·ḥê hay·yō·wm šil·lam·tî nə·ḏā·rāy
verses.literal: I have made my peace . . . offerings today I have paid my vows

verses.original: עַל־ כֵּ֭ן יָצָ֣אתִי לִקְרָאתֶ֑ךָ לְשַׁחֵ֥ר פָּ֝נֶ֗יךָ וָאֶמְצָאֶֽךָּ׃
verses.transliteration: ‘al- kên yā·ṣā·ṯî liq·rā·ṯe·ḵā lə·ša·ḥêr pā·ne·ḵā wā·’em·ṣā·’e·kā
verses.literal: So . . . I came out to meet you I sought you . . . and I have found you

verses.original: רָבַ֣דְתִּי עַרְשִׂ֑י מַ֭רְבַדִּים חֲ֝טֻב֗וֹת אֵט֥וּן מִצְרָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: rā·ḇaḏ·tî ‘ar·śî mar·ḇad·dîm ḥă·ṭu·ḇō·wṯ ’ê·ṭūn miṣ·rā·yim
verses.literal: I have decked my bed with coverings with colored linen from Egypt

verses.original: נַ֥פְתִּי מִשְׁכָּבִ֑י מֹ֥ר אֲ֝הָלִ֗ים וְקִנָּמֽוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: nap̄·tî miš·kā·ḇî mōr ’ă·hā·lîm wə·qin·nā·mō·wn
verses.literal: I have perfumed my bed with myrrh with aloes and with cinnamon

verses.original: לְכָ֤ה נִרְוֶ֣ה דֹ֭דִים עַד־ הַבֹּ֑קֶר נִ֝תְעַלְּסָ֗ה בָּאֳהָבִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: lə·ḵāh nir·weh ḏō·ḏîm ‘aḏ- hab·bō·qer niṯ·‘al·lə·sāh bā·’o·hā·ḇîm
verses.literal: Come let us take our fill of love till morning Let us delight in loving caresses

verses.original: כִּ֤י הָאִ֣ישׁ אֵ֣ין בְּבֵית֑וֹ הָ֝לַ֗ךְ מֵרָחֽוֹק׃ בְּדֶ֣רֶךְ
verses.transliteration: kî hā·’îš ’ên bə·ḇê·ṯōw hā·laḵ mê·rā·ḥō·wq bə·ḏe·reḵ
verses.literal: For my husband is not at home he has gone on a long journey

verses.original: לָקַ֣ח בְּיָד֑וֹ צְֽרוֹר־ הַ֭כֶּסֶף יָבֹ֥א בֵיתֽוֹ׃ לְי֥וֹם הַ֝כֵּ֗סֶא
verses.transliteration: lā·qaḥ bə·yā·ḏōw ṣə·rō·wr- hak·ke·sep̄ yā·ḇō ḇê·ṯōw lə·yō·wm hak·kê·se
verses.literal: He took with him a bag of money and will not return . . . till the moon [is] full

verses.original: בְּרֹ֣ב לִקְחָ֑הּ הִ֭טַּתּוּ בְּחֵ֥לֶק שְׂ֝פָתֶ֗יהָ תַּדִּיחֶֽנּוּ׃
verses.transliteration: bə·rōḇ liq·ḥāh hiṭ·ṭat·tū bə·ḥê·leq śə·p̲ā·t̲ê·hā tad·dî·ḥen·nū
verses.literal: With her great persuasion she entices him with her flattering lips she lures him

verses.original: ה֤וֹלֵ֥ךְ אַחֲרֶ֗יהָ פִּ֫תְאֹ֥ם כְּ֭שׁוֹר יָב֑וֹא אֶל־ טָ֣בַח אֱוִֽיל׃ וּ֝כְעֶ֗כֶס אֶל־ מוּסַ֥ר
verses.transliteration: hō·w·lêḵ ’a·ḥă·re·hā piṯ·’ōm kə·šō·wr yā·ḇō·w ’el- ṭå̄·ḇaḥ ’ĕ·wîl ū·ḵə·‘e·ḵes ’el- mū·sar
verses.literal: He follows her . . . on impulse like an ox going to the slaughter like a deer bounding into a trap

verses.original: עַ֤ד חֵ֡ץ יְפַלַּ֪ח כְּֽבֵד֗וֹ צִפּ֣וֹר כְּמַהֵ֣ר אֶל־ פָּ֑ח וְלֹֽא־ יָ֝דַ֗ע כִּֽי־ הֽוּא׃פ בְנַפְשׁ֥וֹ
verses.transliteration: ‘aḏ ḥêṣ yə·p̄al·laḥ kə·ḇê·ḏōw ṣip·pō·wr kə·ma·hêr ’el- pāḥ wə·lō- yā·ḏa‘ kî- hū ḇə·nap̄·šōw
verses.literal: until an arrow pierces his liver like a bird darting into a snare not knowing . . . it will cost him his life

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֣ה בָ֭נִים שִׁמְעוּ־ לִ֑י וְ֝הַקְשִׁ֗יבוּ לְאִמְרֵי־ פִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘at·tāh ḇā·nîm šim·‘ū- lî wə·haq·šî·ḇū lə·’im·rê- p̄î
verses.literal: Now my sons listen to me and attend to the words of my mouth

verses.original: אַל־ לִבֶּ֑ךָ יֵ֣שְׂטְ אֶל־ דְּרָכֶ֣יהָ אַל־ תֵּ֝תַע בִּנְתִיבוֹתֶֽיהָ׃
verses.transliteration: ’al- lib·be·ḵā yê·śəṭ ’el- də·rā·ḵe·hā ’al- tê·ṯa‘ bin·ṯî·ḇō·w·ṯe·hā
verses.literal: Do not let your heart turn aside to her ways do not stray into her paths

verses.original: כִּֽי־ רַבִּ֣ים הִפִּ֑ילָה חֲלָלִ֣ים הֲרֻגֶֽיהָ׃ וַ֝עֲצֻמִ֗ים כָּל־
verses.transliteration: kî- rab·bîm hip·pî·lāh ḥă·lā·lîm hă·ru·ḡe·hā wa·‘ă·ṣu·mîm kāl-
verses.literal: For she has brought many down to death her slain are many in number

verses.original: בֵּיתָ֑הּ דַּרְכֵ֣י שְׁא֣וֹל יֹ֝רְד֗וֹת אֶל־ חַדְרֵי־ מָֽוֶת׃פ
verses.transliteration: bê·ṯāh dar·ḵê šə·’ō·wl yō·rə·ḏō·wṯ ’el- ḥaḏ·rê- mā·weṯ
verses.literal: Her house is the road to Sheol descending to the chambers of death
